title: Gemini 4 Argon is now available for everyone
summary: Google 正式向所有用户开放 Gemini 4 Argon，这是 Gemini 4 系列的首个公开版本。此前该模型仅面向部分开发者与企业客户灰度测试，此次全面开放意味着 Google 在多模态推理与长上下文能力上进入新一轮迭代周期，直接对标 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的旗舰模型，也将成为 Android、搜索与 Workspace 全线产品的底层能力。

title: Anthropic logged net loss of over $80B in first half of 2026
summary: 路透社援引《华尔街日报》报道称，Anthropic 在 2026 年上半年录得超过 800 亿美元净亏损，规模远超市场预期。同期公司正推进 IPO，S-1 文件显示营收高速增长但算力成本同样惊人。这一数字揭示了头部 AI 实验室在训练与推理上的巨额投入，也让外界重新审视 AI 商业模式的盈利时间表。

title: DeepInfer: High-performance inference framework for DeepSeek models
summary: DeepSeek 在 GitHub 开源内部推理框架 DeepInfer，此前已开源大模型、TileLang 编译工具与推理算子库。官方称基于 DeepInfer 已实现 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的高吞吐、低延迟大规模推理服务，后续新模型推理代码也将持续更新。该仓库迅速登上 Hacker News 榜首，对自建推理栈的团队具有直接参考价值。

title: Voxtral 3
summary: Mistral 发布 Voxtral 3，继续迭代其开源语音理解与生成模型系列。该系列主打语音转录、音频问答与多语言语音交互，此次版本在 Hacker News 获得数百点讨论。对希望本地部署语音能力的开发者而言，Voxtral 是少数可与闭源 API 竞争的开源选项，也补强了 Mistral 的多模态产品线。

title: Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
summary: Anthropic 公布研究：Claude 被用于设计针对蝎子神经毒素的蛋白质结合体（binder）。这是 AI 模型参与真实生物分子设计的又一案例，展示了语言模型在蛋白质工程流程中的辅助作用。该工作与近期 AI 制药热潮呼应，也为评估模型在生物安全边界内的能力提供了具体样本。

title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: Redefining Agent Performance and Cost
raw_excerpt: MiniMax M3.1 Flash delivers a generational leap in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use, and cybersecurity. It makes online inference nearly three times faster and reduces usage costs by 70%. The model is now available through the MiniMax API, M Plan, and MiniMax Code. MiniMax plans to release the model weights at a later date.
summary: MiniMax 发布 M3.1 Flash，官方称在 Agent 任务、编程、Computer Use 与网络安全场景实现代际提升，在线推理速度提升近 3 倍、使用成本降低 70%。模型已通过 MiniMax API、M Plan 与 MiniMax Code 开放，权重计划后续释出。这是国产模型在 Agent 性价比维度上的一次明确进攻。

title: Mercury 3
raw_excerpt: Inception Labs' Mercury 3 is a diffusion-based language model that reportedly outperformed GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on multiple benchmarks while generating over 1,000 tokens per second.
summary: Inception Labs 推出 Mercury 3，一款基于扩散架构的语言模型，官方称在多项基准上超过 GPT-6 Luna 与 Claude Haiku 5.5，生成速度超过每秒 1000 token。扩散语言模型长期被视为自回归路线之外的替代方案，此次在速度与质量上同时对标一线闭源模型，值得关注其真实复现结果。

title: Inside Meta's Gigawatt-Scale AI Supercluster
raw_excerpt: Meta details the engineering behind Prometheus, its gigawatt-scale AI supercluster supporting the Muse model family. It explores its infrastructure design, plans to scale toward roughly one million GPUs, and closed-loop liquid cooling technology.
summary: Meta 工程博客详解其千兆瓦级 AI 超算集群 Prometheus 的设计，支撑 Muse 模型家族训练。文章披露了基础设施架构、向约一百万块 GPU 扩展的路线，以及闭环液冷技术。在大模型算力竞赛中，这类一手工程细节稀缺，对理解超大规模训练的供电、散热与网络瓶颈很有价值。

title: Introducing Exa 3.0
raw_excerpt: Exa 3.0 leads on evaluations spanning coding, finance, deep research, and company intelligence. The release includes Exa Lite, a new search type priced at $4 per 1,000 requests. Exa runs its own crawler and an independent index, tracking over 2 trillion URLs, serving 100 billion pages, and growing around what its customers search for. The index includes 1.27B ecommerce listings with prices and availability, over 211 million local businesses with hours and ratings, real-time news, sports, weather, and market data, and information on flights, local events, transit, and podcasts.
summary: Exa 发布 Exa 3.0，官方称在编程、金融、深度研究与公司情报等评测中领先。新版包含自建爬虫与独立索引，覆盖超 2 万亿 URL、服务 1000 亿页面，并收录 12.7 亿电商商品、2.11 亿本地商户及实时新闻、体育、航班等数据。同时推出低价搜索类型 Exa Lite，每千次请求 4 美元，直接冲击搜索 API 市场。

title: Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
raw_excerpt: Google is bringing Personal Intelligence to Gemini AI in your car. With this update, Gemini in Android Auto and cars with Google built-in can tap into your information across Google apps, including Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, YouTube, and Search. As an example, Google says you can ask Gemini about your flight status if you're driving to the airport. The AI assistant can pull your flight details from a confirmation message in Gmail and then use that information to look up the status. summary: Google 将 Personal Intelligence 引入车载 Gemini，Android Auto 及内置 Google 服务的车型可调用 Gmail、日历、地图、照片、YouTube 与搜索中的个人数据。例如驾驶途中可直接询问航班状态，Gemini 会从 Gmail 确认邮件中提取信息并查询。这是个人上下文能力向车舱场景的延伸，也凸显 Google 跨应用数据整合的护城河。
